title: Scene Runtime Uses Three Fixture Only
description: Remove semio authoring-plane coordinate conversion from the Three/R3F scene runtime. Scene consumes elements.scene.fixture/v1 with origin+orientation already in standard Three.js Y-up world space. Keep authoring→fixture conversion only in the nakagin bake path (authoringToThreeFixture + semioDesignPlane ingestion). Delete coordsPlane; move embedded tests off react/index.
